fields.Name: IT110 - Search Scope Bound
fields.Description: A scoped search is bounded by its scope's rows, against a live database, with no model, embedding, index or network: a SearchEngine test subclass injects one stub provider entry (returning hand-built 'fulltext' hits) under the ID of a borrowed MJ: Search Providers row. Setup creates, as the run user, a non-global Active MJ: Search Scopes row (its save auto-grants the creator a Manage permission) with one MJ: Search Scope Entities lane on MJ: AI Agents whose ExtraFilter is ID='<agent A>', and reloads SearchEngineBase. SSB1: with NO provider rows the scoped search runs no provider and returns nothing, although a provider is configured; the logged scope decision and ExplainScope are both Reachable:false with the no-provider-rows diagnostic. SSB2: after an enabled MJ: Search Scope Providers row is added, the stub's full-text hits for agents A and B (both readable by the run user) are held to the lane ExtraFilter, so only A survives. SSB3: the search-log rows, the auto-granted permission, the provider row, the lane and the scope are deleted and confirmed gone; Teardown removes anything a failed check left behind.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A non-global scope with no provider rows runs no provider and is Reachable:false; a lane ExtraFilter holds a non-entity provider's hits to the filter; the fixture rows are removed.
